ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity mottled zones are located at the extreme lateral distal margins of both lobes. The central region around the notch and the lower midsections are predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and shallow valleys with pixel amplitudes varying between 5-15 units relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the tips, with a distinct upward inflection at the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groupings (white rosettes) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear marks visible; a prominent cluster of diagonal parallel lines on the right lobe and scattered individual horizontal/diagonal lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral fluke tips; multiple linear rake marks traversing the dark pigmentation of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical white mottled patches localized specifically to the outer 15% of the fluke's lateral span.
